$comment: Delete every $comment once the best practice is written. <role>: the role the goal names, such as "the developer". <achieves what>: what the role achieves with the deliverable. <kind>: the kind of deliverable, such as "ux". <ext>: the deliverable's own format, such as "md". The example is optional, until one deliverable of the kind is made.

user_benefits.$comment: One for each section of the template, each dependency among sections and the whole, in the order the generator thinks them. <section>: a heading of the template as written there, or "the whole". <When>: the moment a role uses the section, such as "Reading the goal". <role>: the role that uses it, the one the goal names or one that serves it, such as "the evaluator". <get what>: what that role needs from it there toward the goal.

practices.$comment: One for each question, in the questions' order. <do what>: the way that makes the question yes, as one action of the generator. <why>: what makes that way meet the question, optional. <step>: one action the thinking alone does not lead the generator to, optional. <case>: when the step applies, optional.
